text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall-ml — elevated error rate on embeddings-service canary (region us-west2) after rollout of commit abc1234 at 21:04 UTC

oncall-ml: I’m on it, grabbing context.

sara: seeing 5xx spikes and mismatched vector dims in prod-canary logs, looks like a tokenizer change slipped into the commit.

mike: confirm that this only affects canary traffic (10%). production prod is still on previous version.

deploy-bot: rollout of release/2026-03-15.3 completed to canary group at 21:04 UTC (10% traffic).

oncall-ml: paste logs I'm looking at:```ERROR embeddings.cpp: tokenization failed - expected 512 tokens, got 0
req_id=zc-7001 user=svc-embed source=canary
stack: Tokenizer::encode at tokenizer.cc:237
```

elaine: customer-monitoring shows some downstream customers (three orgs) hitting embedding failures for long inputs — they surface as 500s when ingesting docs. Likely customer impact: failed indexing jobs.

oncall-ml: quick impact check: hits are ~0.8% of total embedding requests in canary, but those are noisy. If we let it continue and the rollout goes to 50% it could start affecting more. Recommend kill-switch for canary immediately.

mike: agreed. KILLFLAG toggle for release/2026-03-15.3 to stop canary rollout and route canary traffic back to stable. Command:```/feature-flag kill release-2026-03-15.3 --env=canary```

ops-bot: Feature flag command accepted. Rolling back canary routing in progress...

deploy-bot: Canary traffic has been routed back to stable. No candidate pods remain serving canary traffic in us-west2.

oncall-ml: good. Next steps: either revert single commit abc1234 from main and rebuild, or ship a 1-line hotpatch to tokenizer that restores previous behavior. Which is faster?

sara: revert + redeploy is straightforward: `git revert abc1234 && ./deploy canary` — but build + canary verification will take ~18-25 minutes. Hotpatch could be quicker if we locate the offending lines.

josh: I'm on the tokenizer diff now. Looks like a behavior change in split_sentences that drops empty sequences when input contains odd Unicode. Patch seems small. I can prepare a patch branch and push a hotfix wheel.

oncall-ml: we need to weigh risk: hotpatch touches tokenizer; quicker but riskier. Revert is lower-risk. Given the low canary exposure and that we already killed the rollout, recommend revert to be safe.

lisa (customer-success): cc'ing impacted accounts: AcmeData, NeuroLabs, BrightIndex. I'll draft notices but hold until we know timeline.

elaine: for SLA/cs we should offer ETA ~30 mins for canary backfill and 2 hours for full rollback+redeploy if we choose that.

oncall-ml: OK doing revert. Steps I will run and update here: 1) open revert PR 2) CI run 3) merge to main 4) trigger canary deploy 5) validate 6) promote.

oncall-ml: running:```git checkout main
git revert --no-edit abc1234
git push origin main
```

ops-bot: Revert PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/reverts/4567 (CI queued)

mike: monitoring CI, please call out if any test flakes.

oncall-ml: CI passed on revert PR. Merging now.```gh pr merge 4567 --squash```

deploy-bot: New build triggered from main at 21:28 UTC. Canary deploy queued.

oncall-ml: canary is up in us-west2 with reverted build. Running sanity checks: small smoke script and embedding test harness.```curl -X POST https://canary.embedding/api/v1/encode -d '{"text":"hello world"}' | jq .size```

oncall-ml: smoke looks good. Running long input fuzz tests (10k tokens reproduction) now.

sara: during rollout, enabling extra logging for tokenizer errors for 15m window:```export TOKENIZER_DEBUG=1```

ops-bot: Canary metrics: error rate back down to baseline. No 500s observed in past 3 minutes.

elaine: updating CS: drafted message, ETA ~25-35 minutes for larger backfill, currently canary stopped and service stable.

customer-success: please include that we will proactively reprocess failed index jobs once full rollout completes.

oncall-ml: after canary verification for 10 minutes, I'll promote to 50% then 100%. Monitoring passenger queue and error budget.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0427. Priority: P2. Commander: oncall-ml.

mike: quick note — log shows one side-effect: metric label `token_length_bucket` changed in the new build, we should check metrics ingestion mapping for dashboards.

oncall-ml: noted, will file follow-up infra-ticket for metric mapping.

josh: followup: found root cause — `split_sentences` used `u.strip()` which removed zero-width joiners in some unicode sequences; reverted. Patch LGTM.

lisa: CS update sent to customers with temporary mitigation and expected timelines.

elaine: postmortem action items: 1) add tokenizer regression unit tests (including unicode edgecases), 2) require tokenizer integration gating in CI for releases touching tokenizer, 3) improve canary kill-switch runbook to include automatic routing rollback step verified by deploy-bot.

oncall-ml: handing off to day team for follow-up and postmortem ops. If anything flares, page me.

oncall-ml: closing thread — final status: rollback via revert merged and promoted, canary error rate normalized, impacted customers notified, follow-ups filed (TKT-9872, TKT-9873). :white_check_mark:
